description: Adds a fixed voltage to a control voltage, set in coarse and fine steps, with an optional sample and hold

params.text: Sets the offset in whole volts, -8V to +8V. A cable in the COARSE CV input takes over from this knob
Adds anything between -1V and +1V to the offset, continuously

inputs.text: The voltage the offset is added to; polyphonic, with every channel offset by the same amount
Sets the coarse part of the offset from a voltage rather than the COARSE knob, rounded down to whole volts
With a cable here, the input and offset are sampled on each rising edge and held until the next one; with nothing patched, changes reach the output immediately

outputs.text: Carries the input plus the offset, clamped to 12V either way

inputs.2: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
